disclaimer: PROVENANCE AND VERIFICATION WARNING — READ BEFORE USING AS GROUND TRUTH. No clause_text in this file is a verbatim quotation from a decided case or a real lease. Every entry is either 'synthetic_representative' (written to exemplify a pattern) or 'reconstructed_from_holding' (paraphrasing the clause type a cited decision addressed — the wording is ours, not the court's). There are no verbatim field samples: a verbatim claim now requires the document it was transcribed from, enforced by the validator. VERIFICATION. source.verified is true ONLY where a human has confirmed the citation against the primary text, and the validator enforces that it implies verification_status == 'primary_source_verified'. As of v4 that count is ZERO. Primary sources (裁判所, 国土交通省, RETIO) were not reachable from the build environment, so 12 citations were cross-read against secondary summaries only ('secondary_source_checked') and 35 remain 'unverified'; the other 33 are our own fixtures ('not_applicable_synthetic') and assert no judgment. Secondary cross-reading already caught two real errors — see the 敷引 attribution note in bands.ts and the TK-0029 citation note — which is why the flag is not flipped wholesale. Nothing derived from this corpus should reach a user until a human has pulled 判例集 / the MLIT guideline PDF / RETIO for the 47 entries that assert an external source. SCORING CONVENTIONS. (1) A prong is true when SATISFIED, false when it FAILS, 'unknown' when the record lacks the facts to score it; 'unknown' is never collapsed into false. (2) P3 is PROPORTIONALITY ONLY — whether the amount sits inside its band in bands.ts. (3) P4 follows 最判平成17年12月16日 applied uniformly: for a depreciation-sensitive pattern, a clause shifting cost irrespective of occupancy, age or degree of wear may score P4 true only where the clause records explanation or assent — compare TK-0079 with TK-0080, TK-0054, TK-0016 and TK-0037. (4) P4 true presupposes P1 and P2. (5) 一部無効 splits two ways: 'reducible' means the AMOUNT is cut back (P3 false, clause valid); 'severable' means the SCOPE is cut back (P4 false, but the clause named damage the tenant could have caused — void as to 通常損耗, alive for that damage, which art. 621(1) imposes independently). Collapsing them into 'unenforceable' would tell a tenant they owe nothing when they partly do. All conventions are enforced mechanically by tests/golden-set/validate-corpus.ts.

Evidence: 条文を二次資料で照合（2026-09-14）: 「賃借人は、賃借物を受け取った後にこれに生じた損傷（通常の使用及び収益によって生じた賃借物の損耗並びに賃借物の経年変化を除く。）がある場合において、賃貸借が終了したときは、その損傷を原状に復する義務を負う。ただし、その損傷が賃借人の責めに帰することができない事由によるものであるときは、この限りでない。」2020年施行の債権法改正で明文化。e-Gov 原本は未確認。
